mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS 3-month decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE 1-month increase does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO 1-month increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strengthening economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal during late-cycle expansion, or GDPC1 3-month increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r < 0.1).
